payload.summary: Fixed-width and fixed-character-count elements truncate clinical text at every viewport
payload.detail: Three instances sharing one cause. on-call-home.tsx:211 ward chips are a hard w-32 at every viewport, truncating 'Demo Emergenc...' at 320 through 1920 where ~1180px of the row is empty. services-navigator-page.tsx:160-166 applies a 150-character cap identically at 320 and 1920; on the 13YARN crisis line the cut lands on 'Immedia...', removing the availability statement. /on-call/contacts squeezes the name column to two words at 390. Also /medications/acamprosate clamps dose strings (dose, frequency and daily total) to two lines.
